title: Comprehensive diagnostics battery
cited_as: van den Heuvel et al. 2026; Siddiqi et al. 2026; Zalesky & Cash 2026
differences_from_source: Not a published pipeline: it runs every diagnostic of the Map battery strip that the cited papers debate (degree/PC1 QA, a relocation null reference, specificity with label permutation and a volume covariate, validation against baselines, threshold and connectome robustness, provenance).
Each diagnostic uses this library's implementation and defaults (addendum section 3).
description: Every diagnostic of the battery strip in one run. It takes the longest; it does not make a result specific.
